about:
Tools for Working Wood operates a retail showroom and online store in Brooklyn, New York. The business has been active since at least 1999, as indicated by its website copyright. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed, though a blog authored by someone named Joel appears on the site, suggesting a founder or key figure.

The company sells a curated selection of woodworking tools and accessories, including draw knives, bow saw kits, and hardware kits for handle attachment. It maintains a physical showroom open weekdays from 9:00 to 5:00 and provides telephone customer service during business hours. Orders can be shipped internationally, and the site includes a guarantee and return policy.

The primary customers are woodworkers, carpenters, and craft enthusiasts seeking hand tools and specialty items. Products such as the Gramercy Tools Bow Saw Kits and spoonmaker’s draw knives illustrate the focus on traditional hand-tool woodworking. The store also offers hardware kits for attaching handles to draw knives.

The company emphasizes a personal investment in craft, offering a guarantee and return policy alongside direct phone support. Its Brooklyn location allows local customers to visit the showroom, while the online store serves a broader audience. The site is coded in New York and powered by a local technology partner.
